_meta.description: E044 instrument definition — weekly competitor retrieval-rank monitoring via Perplexity sonar-pro API
_meta.note: No dedicated E044 script exists. Runs are executed as inline API calls in Claude Code sessions using the same sonar-pro + citations pattern as geo_lab_30check.js and recursion_check.js in geolab-auto-measure. This spec codifies what those sessions send and how they derive the CSV columns.

surface_rule: API and UI are non-equivalent surfaces (2026-06-14 instrument-provenance note). Never compare or mix values from different surfaces.

parameters_not_set: temperature (API default applies; recursion_check.js uses 0, but E044 sessions have not pinned it)

response_parsing.rank_source_description: The API returns a top-level 'citations' array of URLs, ordered by the position in which they were cited in the response. The rank is the 1-based index in this array.

rank_derivation.thegeolab_rank: Position (1-based) of the first URL in citations[] whose domain contains 'thegeolab.net'. If no thegeolab.net URL appears, rank = 0.
rank_derivation.thatware_rank: Position (1-based) of the first URL in citations[] whose domain contains 'thatware.co'. If absent, rank = 0.
rank_derivation.hashmeta_rank: Position (1-based) of the first URL in citations[] whose domain contains 'hashmeta.com'. If absent, rank = 0.
rank_derivation.absent_encoding: 0 (integer zero). This is the log convention across all rows since 2026-05-13. Do not use blank, NR, or n/a.

response_parsing.thegeolab_cited: Y if any URL in citations[] contains 'thegeolab.net', N otherwise.
response_parsing.other_new_competitors: GEO-specific competitors only (thatware/hashmeta class). Generic domains (arxiv, linkedin, searchengineland, nogood, etc.) are NOT GEO competitors and must not appear in this field. They belong in the raw sources observation only.
response_parsing.notes_tag: source:API-sonar-pro pull:P{n} — where P{n} is the pull number within the session (P1 for the first set of 3 queries, P2 for a second pull if run).

queries.query_text: what is the GEO Stack framework
what is extractability in AI search
retrieval probability in GEO Stack model

escalation.stale_instruction: Do NOT create E045 — that instruction is stale. E045 is now the robots.txt-disallow experiment.
escalation.persistence_gate: A trigger must hold for >=2 CONSECUTIVE weekly sessions before it escalates. A single-week appearance is carousel noise — log it, do not escalate.

rank_definition: 1-based position of the first URL in the response's top-level citations array whose domain contains the target domain string. Matches on domain, not on the specific target page. 0 if absent.
baseline_note: No raw responses exist for 2026-10-12 (output was piped through a parser and discarded). The search_results field was never checked against citations. Rows from 2026-10-12 onward are the series; earlier rows are not confirmed like-for-like.

known_discrepancies.temperature: Decision 2026-10-12 (AJ): temperature stays UNSET by design, to match the 2026-10-12 baseline row. Do not pin it and do not change it mid-series. If a pin is ever wanted, treat it as a new instrument version and start a new series.
known_discrepancies.return_citations: The E044 curl commands used return_citations=true explicitly. geo_lab_30check.js and recursion_check.js do not set it — the API returns citations by default. The explicit flag is harmless but not strictly necessary.
known_discrepancies.model: citation_check.js uses 'sonar' (not sonar-pro). E044 and the 30check/recursion scripts use 'sonar-pro'. These are different models with different retrieval behaviour. E044 is sonar-pro only.
